frozen.verdict_rule: CONFIRMED if dR2_O >= 0.10 AND Spearman(O, residual) >= 0.60 in both languages AND O ties or beats both cheap baselines (paired-bootstrap CI on the Spearman difference does not exclude zero against O) AND controls are null AND the argmax band check passes. PARTIAL if O ties the single-site baseline and both beat energy/count/span/cosine. FALSIFIED if dR2_O < 0.05 OR O loses to either cheap baseline with a CI excluding zero. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (dR2 in [0.05, 0.10) or a CI straddling a bar) - reported with the MDE, never rounded into a verdict.
frozen.prediction_matched_contrast: within every group, residual SL refusal of the high-O member < low-O member
